mechanism: IID character stream with delimiter segmentation
generative_object: Independent characters segmented into strings by a blank or delimiter
history_or_state: No inherited state beyond fixed character probabilities
next_event_prediction: Next character is independent of token history; word-length law is geometric under the basic model
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Length-class plateaus or humps; vocabulary width; no syntax; no semantic or long-range successor dependence
decisive_intervention_or_control: Simulate at the observed character probabilities and corpus length; compare vocabulary width, plateaus, length distribution, successor law, and held-out likelihood
icp_relevance: Mandatory memory-free null: a Zipf-like marginal can occur without ICP
strongest_failure_mode: Tested random-text families fail to reproduce full empirical rank structure; rejecting them does not establish ICP

mechanism: Fixed categorical or IID heavy-tail sampling
generative_object: Tokens sampled independently from a fixed categorical distribution or counts treated as discrete size observations
history_or_state: Fixed probability vector; no path-dependent record
next_event_prediction: After conditioning on the fixed probability vector, the next-token law is invariant to order and accumulated history
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Multinomial fluctuation pattern; shuffled and original sequences have the same law; Heaps behavior follows only under explicit independence and growth assumptions
decisive_intervention_or_control: Hold final frequencies fixed; permute order; compare original and IID sequential likelihood, discovery path, block dependence, and document heterogeneity
icp_relevance: Baseline against which history-sensitive prediction must improve
strongest_failure_mode: A visually straight rank plot and even an acceptable marginal fit do not validate temporal independence

generative_object: Innovation plus cumulative advantage or proportional reinforcement
history_or_state: Accumulated type counts and innovation parameter
next_event_prediction: Existing-type hazard rises with accumulated count; innovation probability follows the specified schedule
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Age and first-mover effects; linked vocabulary growth and tail; response to count equalization; model-specific innovation trajectory
decisive_intervention_or_control: Match histories on total size but perturb prior counts or innovation opportunity; test next-event hazards and linked vocabulary growth
icp_relevance: Direct candidate history-to-future-law mechanism; counts are a history-formed predictive state
strongest_failure_mode: Constant-innovation Simon growth predicts linear vocabulary growth and lacks syntax, semantics, and local support constraints

generative_object: Optimization of a signal-referent association matrix under speaker-hearer cost trade-off
history_or_state: Learned association matrix and cost weight lambda
next_event_prediction: Signal choice depends on referent and the optimized code; changing costs should alter the whole code
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Mutual information, lexicon size, ambiguity, and phase-transition behavior move jointly with the rank distribution
decisive_intervention_or_control: Manipulate or stratify communicative costs and referent distribution; test held-out signal choice plus mutual information and ambiguity
icp_relevance: Possible embodied organization if the association structure is physically learned and carrier-tested
strongest_failure_mode: Toy equilibrium model with uniform referents and tuned transition; does not identify how history forms or stores the matrix

generative_object: Pooling narrow conditional distributions over a broad hidden condition
history_or_state: Current hidden condition, topic, stimulus, part of speech, or source mixture
next_event_prediction: Conditioned next-event laws differ by latent state; pooled marginal may be Zipfian even when strata are not
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Zipf weakens under conditioning; energy variance and correlations may be explained by common drive; large between-document fluctuation
decisive_intervention_or_control: Condition on preregistered latent variables and fit hierarchical models; compare pooled, per-document, and held-out conditional likelihood
icp_relevance: Usually an ICP confound; becomes relevant only if the latent state is persistent, embodied, and manipulable
strongest_failure_mode: Unmeasured or poorly chosen strata can leave residual scaling; a latent label is not automatically a causal carrier

generative_object: Probability landscape interpreted through energy E=-log P and entropy-density relations
history_or_state: Interaction network, couplings, and operating point in a fitted model
next_event_prediction: Perturbing couplings or common input should change susceptibility, correlations, and finite-size scaling, not only rank slope
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Heat-capacity or susceptibility peaks; finite-size scaling; long-range correlations; approach of operating point toward a critical point
decisive_intervention_or_control: Vary system size and perturb couplings or shared drive; repeat after latent conditioning and under alternative model classes
icp_relevance: Conditional candidate if a physical interaction carrier produces distinctive perturbation response
strongest_failure_mode: Effective-temperature deformation is model based; broad latent mixtures can produce Zipf and critical-like signatures without intrinsic tuning

generative_object: Entropy-maximizing distribution subject to a log-moment or related constraint
history_or_state: Analyst-declared expectation constraints unless a physical enforcement mechanism is shown
next_event_prediction: No unique sequential prediction beyond the fitted constraint family; changing the log moment changes exponent and adding a mean constraint adds a cutoff
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Predicted exponent-constraint relation and possible exponential cutoff; no native age, successor, or relaxation signature
decisive_intervention_or_control: Manipulate a physically identified constraint and test the predicted family while comparing generative alternatives
icp_relevance: Inference scaffold, not evidence of an embodied constraint by itself
strongest_failure_mode: The chosen constraint can encode the desired distribution and does not explain formation, storage, or causal enforcement

generative_object: History-dependent walk in which the admissible successor set shrinks, with reset and optional noise
history_or_state: Current state or prefix and the nested set of still-accessible successors
next_event_prediction: Successor support is directional and systematically pruned; reset/noise controls excursions and exponent
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Nestedness; transition asymmetry; run lengths; reset statistics; loss of path signature after shuffling or time reversal
decisive_intervention_or_control: Preserve unigram counts while shuffling sequence; test reachable-support nestedness, reverse-time asymmetry, and held-out sequential likelihood
icp_relevance: Closest literal candidate for counterfactual future-state restriction
strongest_failure_mode: Downward order, binary support, and resets are constructed; estimated nestedness may summarize grammar or topic rather than a physical carrier

generative_object: Longitudinal evolution of a truncated size distribution and system population
history_or_state: Evolving cutoffs, exponent, and number of elements
next_event_prediction: A genuinely Zipfian trajectory maintains a coherence relation among support growth and population size; a fixed distribution can appear Zipfian temporarily
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Evolution of cutoff ratio, De Marzo coherence quantity, number of types, and Heaps scaling
decisive_intervention_or_control: Analyze preregistered prefixes or time slices; vary aggregation and sampling depth; test whether apparent Zipf persists coherently
icp_relevance: Useful diagnostic of co-evolving accessible space, but not a unique ICP mechanism
strongest_failure_mode: Many causal processes can satisfy coherence; results depend on cutoffs, time variable, and truncated-power-law assumptions

mechanism: Prescribed rank law and order-dependent discovery
generative_object: A fixed final count ranking plus a rule or ordering for token arrival
history_or_state: Final frequency multiset and temporal arrangement are distinct objects
next_event_prediction: The same marginal admits a range of novelty and type-token trajectories; exact asymptotics require the stated deterministic growth construction
predictions_beyond_zipf_slope: Logarithmic corrections near rank exponent one; extremal accelerated and delayed discovery envelopes; domain-specific shuffle effects
decisive_intervention_or_control: Compare original order, token shuffle, and block shuffle with fixed final counts; report local type-token slope and extremal envelope position
icp_relevance: Demonstrates why future discovery is the ICP-relevant target and why Heaps is not independent support without temporal analysis
strongest_failure_mode: A derived Zipf-Heaps relation under one growth construction is not a universal sampling theorem or a carrier test
